assertions.name: sigma3_slope_far_below_nodd_slope

result.verdict: SUPPORT for #3927 A3: the 5₂ σ3 bar-odd datum Im 𝔙_q(5₂)=Im(ι₁₃) is a smooth, MONOTONE, anchor-independent carrier — no zero crossing near the substrate (Re≈0.45, Im≈−0.64 across [1.02,1.50]) and slope 0.1965 at q₀, ~12.1× SMALLER than A′(q*)=2.37. So the σ3 datum supplies the anchor-independent bar-odd CARRIER but NEITHER N_odd's zero-at-q* NOR its slope; for A3's `u³·smooth × Im 𝔙_q(5₂) = N_odd` to hold, the u³·smooth prefactor must carry the zero and amplify the slope ~12×. This CONSTRAINS the A3 prefactor (not a passive normalization). scope-(a): the raw σ3 datum alone does not reproduce the N_odd shape (magnitude/shape mismatch, not ingredient exclusion) — it stays a valid carrier in the composed A3 form. NO fit; NO c_k wired; μ never fixed from QOU data.
